content: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey arrives on digital, 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray on Nov. 17, giving audiences another opportunity to experience the filmmaker's ambitious adaptation of Homer's epic poem. Among the story's many memorable encounters is Circe, a powerful sorceress who turns Odysseus' men into pigs. Played by Samantha Morton, Circe is responsible for one of the film's most unsettling sequences, which involves a human head being transformed into that of a pig.
